proposition.claim:
Relative Mahalanobis++ applies feature normalization to both class and global fits before evaluating the relative score.

Lemma 3.1 defines the squared-norm variance using covariance eigenvalues and unqualified original mean coordinates.

All considered cosine/KNN cases improve; Table4 has30/44 Maha++ wins; relative normalization improves across models/datasets.

assumptions: Normalized class caches exist; normalized global caches do not; caller supplies raw training features.
Every covariance in the witness is positive definite; score is the paper's finite-feature estimator.
X is Gaussian; Sigma positive definite.
Original mean coordinates are not silently redefined after rotation.
